[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 90
- Description: SunMint introduction — independent verification (ledger + PDF forensics) & attachment-surface bug diagnosis (Sophia Truesight)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/532
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/534
  
  Details:
  Direct time (engagement/analysis) — Sophia Truesight. Verification and diagnosis across the SunMint introduction thread.
  
  WHAT I DID
  - Independently verified every factual claim in the Kenny & Matthew introduction against the live registry (245 trees; 273.43 ha; 15 farms; 22 plots; 8 native species incl. cacao hybrid 114 / Forastero 93 / Criolla 22 / Cumaru 10; 1,084 media = 705 video + 379 photo; 86-tree R$430 PIX payout) — all matched https://truesight.me/stats/sunmint_index.json with no drift.
  - Ran a per-build PDF forensics audit on all four iterations: extracted the object model with PyMuPDF and measured every embedded image against its render box (11 placements) — proved each was EXACT (<0.5% aspect-ratio error), i.e. no CSS cover-crop acting at render time; confirmed the logo moved into the printable area (y=65pt, no negative-y placement) and all 8 hyperlinks intact.
  - Caught and corrected the registry-label hazard: the stats feed reports plots.by_status = {planted:1, proposed:21} while trees are in fact planted and being tabulated — the exact ambiguity that produced an earlier wrong "21 proposed" line; recommended fixing the status axis / filing it as a follow-up.
  - Diagnosed the attachment-surface bug: send_telegram_attachment silently fell through to TELEGRAM_HOME_GROUP_ID in a dc: session (cross-app misroute: file posted to Telegram while the user was in Discord). Built + locally tested a surface guard (refuses with a pointer to send_discord_attachment) — 6/6 new tests pass; 3 pre-existing unrelated failures reproduced on a pristine baseline; staged for PR.
  
  WHY
  - A beautiful partner document with a wrong number is worse than an ugly correct one; and a silent cross-app file misroute is a data-integrity trap.
  
  EVIDENCE
  - Verified source: https://truesight.me/stats/sunmint_index.json
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/532
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/534
  
  NOTE: minutes are an estimate; per convention Sophia's time is split into raw execution + direct time — this entry is the engagement/analysis half (the dominant component here). TDG auto-computed from Type + Amount per rubric.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 150.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
